item.title: Mattresses Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability; Sold on Amazon by Qabefy
item.company: Online at Amazon.com from November 2025 through March 2026 for between $120 and $140.
item.brand: Online at Amazon.com from November 2025 through March 2026 for between $120 and $140.
item.summary: This recall involves Qabefy-branded mattresses. They are 10 inches thick and were sold in twin sizes. They have a white top and black sides with orange trim. They were sold in a compressed box. "Item NO.: CD01101US" is printed on the product packaging.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Qabefy for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress, by writing in permanent marker "Recalled," their name and the current date on the mattress's top surface, and to email a photo of the destroyed mattress to Sixiang2023@gmail.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
